place.name: Three Bells of Fira
place.description: The Three Bells of Fira (Greek: Τρεις καμπάνες των Φηρών), officially known as the Catholic Church of the Dormition, is an Eastern Catholic Greek Byzantine church, located in the town of Fira, on the island of Santorini, in the Southern Aegean region of Greece. The church is known for its blue dome, three bells and views, located directly above the cliffs which dominate western Santorini.
